freshFunctionalContracts: Installation and candidate building: fixed pinned builders and isolated probes, root-imported manifest, initialization locks, safe release selection, retained previous pointer and failed-first-start recovery.

Trusted control and recovery: ownership checks, exact legacy compatibility only in bound recovery context, pending barriers, stop-confirmed restoration, original stopped/enabled services preserved; generated fixed proxy helpers allowed during pending control while RPC/execute remain blocked.

Execution identity: CLI-only root authorization and ordinary-mode origin guard, exact mode/revision/effective UID, independent native/root homes without credential copying, no request-selected UID/home, exact sudo verbs and attachment group retained.

Auto project paths: leading slash selects absolute path; other paths normalize against effective identity home/projects, including multi-segment dot and parent paths. Only the default projects root may be initialized, no arbitrary recursive parent creation; resolve is read-only and OS permission failures are reported at the actual identity.

Project mutation and output: mkdir parent permission/identity checks; post-mkdir fsync/readback/encoding failures cannot become replayable not_sent outcomes; literal UTF8 JSON plus newline is bounded to 8192 bytes, input bounded to 4096 bytes. Gateway positive acknowledgement preserves acceptance after disconnection and failed registry persistence remains unknown with recovery path.

Providers/accounts/catalog: shared root-managed provider selection and enabled identities, catalog-only launcher argument validation, bounded reads and credential redaction, revisioned durable writes and recovery.

Service proxy: official immutable core verification, bounded download/readiness deadlines, exact generated config and credential path, fixed helper cgroup admission, positive per-instance NFT cgroup selection and ordered rules, PID1-managed membership, management refresh and proxy-aware transaction rollback.
HTTPS and operator: verified hostname/trust/instance proof, fixed TLS/DNS material and release pins, bounded ports and diagnostics, local health not represented as public browser acceptance.

Files and Git: directory-descriptor boundaries, revisions and durable operation witnesses, canonical project identity, fixed Git invocation and private index/view, no recovery rebinding across distinct identity homes.

Documentation and historical evidence: unchanged deployment/recovery and tool lock evidence remain applicable to unchanged contracts; historic test results and three-audit default are not substituted for this authorized one-round gate or current execution.
